_howto: To add a project: put its screenshots in the folder img/work/ (for example img/work/ecommerce-laptop.jpg and img/work/ecommerce-phone.jpg), then set 'laptop' and 'phone' below to those file names. Leave a field as null to keep the 'Mockup coming soon' frame. 'type' must be one of: Website, Mobile app, System. Label projects by type only: never client names. After editing, ask Claude to rebuild and deploy.
